full_name: Beronda L. Montgomery | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Biological Sciences Sally Starling Seaver Fellow Grinnell College
bio: Beronda L. Montgomery is a plant biochemist who studies how organisms perceive, respond to, and are impacted by environments in which they exist. At Radcliffe, she will complete work on her book “When Trees Testify: Reckoning with Black History through the Science and Wisdom of Plants” as well as initiate work on the relationships of select Black feminists with plants and nature.
